title: The Billion Dollar Game That Took 8 Years
sources: Yahoo Tech, 'GTA 6 is out now' (Nov 19, 2026): GTA 6 launched worldwide on November 19, 2026 at midnight local time, after delays
Rockstar Newswire, 'Grand Theft Auto VI is Now Set to Launch November 19, 2026' (Nov 2025); Dexerto: first set for May 2025 window, delayed to May 26 2026, then to Nov 19 2026 (two delays)
The Shortcut / Bloomberg (Jason Schreier): early work, codenamed Project Americas, began with a research trip to Miami in 2015; most of the studio was pulled onto Red Dead Redemption 2
TechWiser (Bloomberg details): developers visited Miami to study its streets, nightlife, police activity
DeltiasGaming / AnimeNew: principal development began after Red Dead Redemption 2, in 2018; about eight years of production
GTABoom (former Rockstar developer): RAGE engine reportedly rebuilt from the ground up (world streaming, physics, lighting, animation, sound)
Everything Edinburgh: thousands of developers across Rockstar's studios contributed
GadgetReview / GamingBolt (May 2026): analysts estimate $1-1.5 billion; Rockstar/Take-Two never disclosed a budget
TweakTown / MP1ST / NME (Mar 2026): some estimates reach about $3 billion including marketing
Gfinity: GTA 5 total estimated production cost about $265 million (a quarter of a billion)
USD to INR ~88: $1 billion = about 8,800 crore rupees

lines.text: Today, after a thirteen-year wait,
GTA 6 finally came out,
and it might be the most expensive game ever made.
See, it all started in 2015,
when a small team flew to Miami
just to study its streets, its nightlife, and even its police.
But Red Dead Redemption 2 got so big
lines.caps: But | Red Dead | Redemption 2 | got | so big

lines.text: that almost everyone was pulled onto it,
so the real work only began in 2018.
lines.caps: so the | real | work | only | began | in 2018.

lines.text: And they didn't just build a city,
they reportedly rebuilt their whole game engine,
physics, lighting, animation, everything.
Thousands of developers,
in studios around the world,
spent about eight years on it.
So how much did it cost?
Rockstar has never said,
but analysts guess one to one and a half billion dollars,
lines.caps: but | analysts | guess | $1 to~one | $1.5~one | billion | dollars,

lines.text: that's over eight thousand crore rupees!
Some even say three billion
once you add marketing,
while GTA 5 cost about a quarter of a billion.
lines.caps: while | GTA 5 | cost | about | a quarter | of a | billion.

lines.text: And after two delays,
it finally landed today,
so the only question is...
are you playing tonight?
